verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents one built-in event-driven automation: transformations can run automatically when a connection sync completes, as an alternative to a fixed schedule. That is a single fixed trigger-action pairing, not a general rule engine for defining conditions and actions on arbitrary events. The 'Fivetran Alerts' item is only a bare title with no described behavior, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: user-definable rule/condition logic, a range of event types beyond sync completion, configurable action types (e.g., outbound webhooks or API calls), a detailed rules or automation documentation page, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Transformations are automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule.
